item.title: Arizona weather forecast: Phoenix sees cooler temperatures
item.description: Cooler temperatures arrived in Arizona on Tuesday.Temperatures fell seven degrees in the Phoenix area, only reaching 86 degrees in the afternoon. This was thanks to a cool front that passed through the region. Winds were still a bit breezy behind the storm system and front, but the winds will lighten up more on Wednesday.Tonight will be clear with a low around 60 in the Valley.
